---
title: "MS&E 125: Applied Statistics"
---

Welcome to MS&E 125. This book accompanies the Spring 2026 offering at Stanford University.

The course is organized in three acts:

- **Act 1: Build Models** (Lectures 1--7) — From raw data to prediction
- **Act 2: Trust Models** (Lectures 8--12) — Statistical inference and diagnostics
- **Act 3: See Further** (Lectures 13--19) — Classification, dimensionality reduction, causality, and the frontier
